# Project Instructions

- Respond in Brazilian Portuguese unless the user asks otherwise; keep answers concise.
- This is a static storefront: `index.html` is the main page, with assets in `css/`, `js/`, and `images/`.
- Make narrow edits; avoid reformatting the large HTML snapshot or scanning unrelated assets.
- For UI changes, validate the affected text or state and reload the local page when practical.
- Keep always-on guidance short; load task-specific skills only when relevant.
- Never expose or commit credentials, tokens, or local secrets.
